--!strict

local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local CityConfig = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CityConfig"))
local CityUtils = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CityUtils"))
local RoadsAndPark = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Districts"):WaitForChild("RoadsAndPark"))
local Buildings = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("Districts"):WaitForChild("Buildings"))

local CityGenerator = {}

function CityGenerator.configureLighting()
	Lighting.ClockTime = 17.8 -- Hoàng hôn rực rỡ chuẩn bị lên đèn neon
	Lighting.Brightness = 2.4
	Lighting.Ambient = Color3.fromRGB(58, 64, 88)
	Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Color3.fromRGB(95, 102, 132)
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
	Lighting.EnvironmentDiffuseScale = 0.85
	Lighting.EnvironmentSpecularScale = 0.9

	for _, child in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
		if child:GetAttribute("__ArenaCityEffect") == true then
			child:Destroy()
		end
	end

	local atmo = Instance.new("Atmosphere")
	atmo.Name = "CityAtmosphere"
	atmo.Density = 0.28
	atmo.Offset = 0.15
	atmo.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 175)
	atmo.Decay = Color3.fromRGB(110, 92, 145)
	atmo.Glare = 0.25
	atmo.Haze = 1.4
	atmo:SetAttribute("__ArenaCityEffect", true)
	atmo.Parent = Lighting

	local bloom = Instance.new("BloomEffect")
	bloom.Name = "CityNeonBloom"
	bloom.Intensity = 0.65
	bloom.Size = 24
	bloom.Threshold = 1.15
	bloom:SetAttribute("__ArenaCityEffect", true)
	bloom.Parent = Lighting

	local cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
	cc.Name = "CityColorGrade"
	cc.Contrast = 0.08
	cc.Saturation = 0.14
	cc.Brightness = 0.02
	cc:SetAttribute("__ArenaCityEffect", true)
	cc.Parent = Lighting

	local sunRays = Instance.new("SunRaysEffect")
	sunRays.Name = "CitySunRays"
	sunRays.Intensity = 0.12
	sunRays.Spread = 0.75
	sunRays:SetAttribute("__ArenaCityEffect", true)
	sunRays.Parent = Lighting
end

function CityGenerator.buildCity(forceRebuild: boolean?): Folder
	local existing = workspace:FindFirstChild(CityConfig.CityFolderName)
	if existing then
		if forceRebuild then
			existing:Destroy()
		elseif existing:IsA("Folder") then
			return existing
		end
	end

	-- Ẩn Baseplate mặc định của Studio để không đè mặt nước biển & mặt đường
	local defaultBaseplate = workspace:FindFirstChild("Baseplate")
	if defaultBaseplate and defaultBaseplate:IsA("BasePart") then
		defaultBaseplate.Transparency = 1
		defaultBaseplate.CanCollide = false
	end

	-- Tắt SpawnLocation mặc định ngoài thành phố nếu có
	for _, child in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if child:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
			child.Enabled = false
			child.Transparency = 1
			child.CanCollide = false
		end
	end

	local cityRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
	cityRoot.Name = CityConfig.CityFolderName
	cityRoot.Parent = workspace

	CityGenerator.configureLighting()
	RoadsAndPark.build(cityRoot)
	Buildings.build(cityRoot)

	-- ========================================================================
	-- ĐẶT CƯ DÂN NPC TƯƠNG TÁC TẠI CÁC ĐỊA ĐIỂM CHÍNH
	-- ========================================================================
	local npcFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	npcFolder.Name = "Citizens"
	npcFolder.Parent = cityRoot

	CityUtils.buildCitizenNpc(
		npcFolder,
		Vector3.new(-22, 1.4, 26),
		Vector3.new(-1, 0, 1),
		"LinhGuide",
		"Linh (Hướng dẫn viên)",
		Color3.fromRGB(56, 189, 248),
		Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
	)
	CityUtils.buildCitizenNpc(
		npcFolder,
		Vector3.new(46, 1.5, -46.5),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
		"MinhBarista",
		"Minh (Barista Cafe)",
		Color3.fromRGB(180, 83, 9),
		Color3.fromRGB(41, 37, 36)
	)
	CityUtils.buildCitizenNpc(
		npcFolder,
		Vector3.new(96, 1.5, -46.5),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
		"HungPizza",
		"Hùng (Quản lý Giao hàng)",
		Color3.fromRGB(220, 38, 38),
		Color3.fromRGB(31, 41, 55)
	)
	CityUtils.buildCitizenNpc(
		npcFolder,
		Vector3.new(-42, 1.5, -47.5),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, 1),
		"LanBanker",
		"Lan (Giao dịch viên)",
		Color3.fromRGB(16, 185, 129),
		Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
	)
	CityUtils.buildCitizenNpc(
		npcFolder,
		Vector3.new(102, 1.5, 74),
		Vector3.new(0, 0, -1),
		"KhoaMechanic",
		"Khoa (Kỹ sư Xe)",
		Color3.fromRGB(249, 115, 22),
		Color3.fromRGB(30, 41, 59)
	)

	-- ========================================================================
	-- ĐẶT SẴN XE HƠI LÁI ĐƯỢC NGAY TRÊN ĐẠI LỘ TRUNG TÂM & GARAGE
	-- ========================================================================
	local vehiclesFolder = Instance.new("Folder")
	vehiclesFolder.Name = "Vehicles"
	vehiclesFolder.Parent = cityRoot

	-- Xe thể thao đỏ đậu ngay gần Quảng Trường Spawn để lên xe lái liền!
	CityUtils.buildVehicleModel(
		vehiclesFolder,
		CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-8, 0.5, 42), Vector3.new(-8, 0.5, -10)),
		Color3.fromRGB(225, 38, 52),
		"StarterSportsCar_Red"
	)

	-- Siêu xe xanh neon trước Auto Metro Garage
	CityUtils.buildVehicleModel(
		vehiclesFolder,
		CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(82, 0.5, 8), Vector3.new(120, 0.5, 8)),
		Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233),
		"GarageCyberCar_Cyan"
	)

	-- Xe vàng thể thao trước khu Tài Chính
	CityUtils.buildVehicleModel(
		vehiclesFolder,
		CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(-58, 0.5, -8), Vector3.new(10, 0.5, -8)),
		Color3.fromRGB(245, 180, 25),
		"FinanceCruiser_Gold"
	)

	return cityRoot
end

return CityGenerator

--!strict

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local CityConfig = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CityConfig"))

local CityUtils = {}

export type PartProps = {
	Name: string?,
	Size: Vector3?,
	Position: Vector3?,
	CFrame: CFrame?,
	Color: Color3?,
	Material: Enum.Material?,
	Transparency: number?,
	Reflectance: number?,
	CanCollide: boolean?,
	Shape: Enum.PartType?,
	CastShadow: boolean?,
	Parent: Instance?,
}

function CityUtils.makePart(props: PartProps): Part
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = props.Name or "Part"
	p.Anchored = true
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	if props.Shape then
		p.Shape = props.Shape
	end
	p.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(4, 1, 4)
	if props.CFrame then
		p.CFrame = props.CFrame
	elseif props.Position then
		p.Position = props.Position
	end
	p.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 205)
	p.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	p.Transparency = props.Transparency or 0
	p.Reflectance = props.Reflectance or 0
	if props.CanCollide ~= nil then
		p.CanCollide = props.CanCollide
	end
	if props.CastShadow ~= nil then
		p.CastShadow = props.CastShadow
	end
	if props.Parent then
		p.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return p
end

function CityUtils.makeWedge(props: PartProps): WedgePart
	local w = Instance.new("WedgePart")
	w.Name = props.Name or "Wedge"
	w.Anchored = true
	w.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	w.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	w.Size = props.Size or Vector3.new(4, 2, 4)
	if props.CFrame then
		w.CFrame = props.CFrame
	elseif props.Position then
		w.Position = props.Position
	end
	w.Color = props.Color or Color3.fromRGB(180, 180, 185)
	w.Material = props.Material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	w.Transparency = props.Transparency or 0
	if props.CanCollide ~= nil then
		w.CanCollide = props.CanCollide
	end
	if props.Parent then
		w.Parent = props.Parent
	end
	return w
end

function CityUtils.makeSignBoard(
	parent: Instance,
	centerPos: Vector3,
	facingDir: Vector3,
	size: Vector2,
	titleText: string,
	subText: string?,
	bgColor: Color3,
	accentColor: Color3
): Part
	local dir = if facingDir.Magnitude > 0.001 then facingDir.Unit else Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	local board = CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "SignBoard_" .. titleText,
		Size = Vector3.new(size.X, size.Y, 0.45),
		CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(centerPos, centerPos + dir),
		Color = bgColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
		Parent = parent,
	})

	-- Viền đèn neon xung quanh bảng hiệu
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "SignNeonTrim",
		Size = Vector3.new(size.X + 0.3, size.Y + 0.3, 0.25),
		CFrame = board.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.12),
		Color = accentColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = parent,
	})

	local sgui = Instance.new("SurfaceGui")
	sgui.Face = Enum.NormalId.Front
	sgui.SizingMode = Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.PixelsPerStud
	sgui.PixelsPerStud = 36
	sgui.LightInfluence = 0.15
	sgui.Brightness = 1.6
	sgui.Parent = board

	local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
	frame.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	frame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	frame.Parent = sgui

	local title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	title.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	title.Size = if subText and subText ~= "" then UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.62) else UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.84)
	title.Position = if subText and subText ~= "" then UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.06) else UDim2.fromScale(0.03, 0.08)
	title.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack
	title.TextScaled = true
	title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
	title.TextStrokeColor3 = accentColor
	title.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.55
	title.Text = titleText
	title.Parent = frame

	if subText and subText ~= "" then
		local sub = Instance.new("TextLabel")
		sub.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sub.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.92, 0.28)
		sub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.66)
		sub.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		sub.TextScaled = true
		sub.TextColor3 = accentColor
		sub.Text = subText
		sub.Parent = frame
	end

	return board
end

function CityUtils.addPrompt(
	parent: Instance,
	actionType: string,
	actionText: string,
	objectText: string,
	maxDist: number?,
	attrs: { [string]: any }?
): ProximityPrompt
	local prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
	prompt.Name = "CityPrompt_" .. actionType
	prompt.ActionText = actionText
	prompt.ObjectText = objectText
	prompt.HoldDuration = 0
	prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
	prompt.MaxActivationDistance = maxDist or 11
	prompt.KeyboardKeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.E
	prompt:SetAttribute("ActionType", actionType)
	if attrs then
		for k, v in pairs(attrs) do
			prompt:SetAttribute(k, v)
		end
	end
	prompt.Parent = parent
	CollectionService:AddTag(prompt, CityConfig.PromptTag)
	return prompt
end

function CityUtils.buildStreetLamp(parent: Instance, basePos: Vector3, armDir: Vector3)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "StreetLamp"
	model.Parent = parent

	local dir = if armDir.Magnitude > 0.01 then Vector3.new(armDir.X, 0, armDir.Z).Unit else Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	local baseCf = CFrame.lookAt(basePos, basePos + dir)

	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Pedestal",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 1.4, 1.4),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 0.7, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(48, 52, 62),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})

	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Pole",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.55, 15, 0.55),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 8.5, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(58, 64, 76),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})

	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Arm",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.45, 4.2),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 15.8, -1.8),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(58, 64, 76),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})

	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Hood",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 0.35, 2.2),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 15.95, -3.4),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 46, 56),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local bulb = CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Bulb",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.15, 0.25, 1.75),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 15.7, -3.4),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 185),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local light = Instance.new("SpotLight")
	light.Name = "StreetLightEmitter"
	light.Face = Enum.NormalId.Bottom
	light.Angle = 115
	light.Range = 42
	light.Brightness = 1.9
	light.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 228, 180)
	light.Shadows = false
	light.Parent = bulb

	CollectionService:AddTag(bulb, CityConfig.StreetLightTag)
	return model
end

function CityUtils.buildTrafficLight(parent: Instance, basePos: Vector3, roadDir: Vector3, axisName: string)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "TrafficLight_" .. axisName
	model:SetAttribute("Axis", axisName)
	model.Parent = parent

	local dir = Vector3.new(roadDir.X, 0, roadDir.Z).Unit
	local baseCf = CFrame.lookAt(basePos, basePos + dir)

	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Post",
		Size = Vector3.new(0.7, 15.5, 0.7),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(0, 7.75, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 56),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})

	-- Tay vươn ngang ra mặt đường
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Cantilever",
		Size = Vector3.new(7.5, 0.5, 0.5),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(3.5, 14.8, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 56),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local box = CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "SignalBox",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.5, 3.8, 1.1),
		CFrame = baseCf * CFrame.new(6.2, 13.5, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(26, 28, 34),
		Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local colors = {
		{ name = "Red", offset = 1.1, onColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 50), offColor = Color3.fromRGB(70, 22, 22) },
		{ name = "Yellow", offset = 0, onColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 205, 40), offColor = Color3.fromRGB(75, 62, 18) },
		{ name = "Green", offset = -1.1, onColor = Color3.fromRGB(45, 245, 110), offColor = Color3.fromRGB(18, 68, 34) },
	}

	for _, c in ipairs(colors) do
		local lens = CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = c.name,
			Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball,
			Size = Vector3.new(0.85, 0.85, 0.85),
			CFrame = box.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, c.offset, -0.42),
			Color = if (axisName == "NS" and c.name == "Green") or (axisName == "EW" and c.name == "Red")
				then c.onColor
				else c.offColor,
			Material = if (axisName == "NS" and c.name == "Green") or (axisName == "EW" and c.name == "Red")
				then Enum.Material.Neon
				else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = model,
		})
		lens:SetAttribute("OnColor", c.onColor)
		lens:SetAttribute("OffColor", c.offColor)
	end

	CollectionService:AddTag(model, CityConfig.TrafficLightTag)
	return model
end

function CityUtils.buildTree(parent: Instance, basePos: Vector3, leafColor: Color3?, scale: number?)
	local s = scale or 1
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "CityTree"
	model.Parent = parent

	-- Bồn cây bằng đá
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "PlanterRim",
		Size = Vector3.new(5.2 * s, 1.1, 5.2 * s),
		Position = basePos + Vector3.new(0, 0.55, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(145, 148, 156),
		Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
		Parent = model,
	})
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Soil",
		Size = Vector3.new(4.4 * s, 1.18, 4.4 * s),
		Position = basePos + Vector3.new(0, 0.58, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(86, 62, 44),
		Material = Enum.Material.Ground,
		Parent = model,
	})

	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Trunk",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.5 * s, 7.5 * s, 1.5 * s),
		Position = basePos + Vector3.new(0, 4.2 * s, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(108, 76, 52),
		Material = Enum.Material.Wood,
		Parent = model,
	})

	local mainLeaf = leafColor or Color3.fromRGB(68, 152, 82)
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "CanopyMain",
		Size = Vector3.new(8.2 * s, 5.4 * s, 8.2 * s),
		Position = basePos + Vector3.new(0, 9.2 * s, 0),
		Color = mainLeaf,
		Material = Enum.Material.Grass,
		Parent = model,
	})
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "CanopyTop",
		Size = Vector3.new(5.6 * s, 3.8 * s, 5.6 * s),
		Position = basePos + Vector3.new(0.4 * s, 12.2 * s, -0.3 * s),
		Color = mainLeaf:Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(190, 245, 160), 0.16),
		Material = Enum.Material.Grass,
		Parent = model,
	})
	return model
end

function CityUtils.buildBench(parent: Instance, centerPos: Vector3, facingDir: Vector3)
	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "ParkBench"
	model.Parent = parent

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(centerPos, centerPos + Vector3.new(facingDir.X, 0, facingDir.Z).Unit)

	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "SeatPlank",
		Size = Vector3.new(6.2, 0.4, 2.0),
		CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 1.6, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(150, 102, 62),
		Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
		Parent = model,
	})
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Backrest",
		Size = Vector3.new(6.2, 1.8, 0.35),
		CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 2.6, 0.85) * CFrame.Angles(math.rad(10), 0, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 94, 56),
		Material = Enum.Material.WoodPlanks,
		Parent = model,
	})
	for _, xOff in ipairs({ -2.6, 2.6 }) do
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "Leg",
			Size = Vector3.new(0.4, 1.6, 1.9),
			CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(xOff, 0.8, 0),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 56),
			Material = Enum.Material.Metal,
			Parent = model,
		})
	end

	-- 2 chỗ ngồi thực tế
	for _, xSeat in ipairs({ -1.5, 1.5 }) do
		local seat = Instance.new("Seat")
		seat.Name = "BenchSeat"
		seat.Anchored = true
		seat.Size = Vector3.new(2.2, 0.4, 1.8)
		seat.Transparency = 1
		seat.CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(xSeat, 1.8, 0)
		seat.Parent = model
	end
	return model
end

function CityUtils.buildCitizenNpc(
	parent: Instance,
	feetPos: Vector3,
	facingDir: Vector3,
	npcId: string,
	displayName: string,
	shirtColor: Color3,
	pantsColor: Color3
): Model
	local npc = Instance.new("Model")
	npc.Name = "NPC_" .. npcId
	npc:SetAttribute("NpcId", npcId)
	npc.Parent = parent

	local cf = CFrame.lookAt(feetPos, feetPos + Vector3.new(facingDir.X, 0, facingDir.Z).Unit)

	local torso = CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Torso",
		Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1),
		CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0),
		Color = shirtColor,
		Parent = npc,
	})
	npc.PrimaryPart = torso

	local head = CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Head",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.25, 1.25, 1.25),
		CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 4.65, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 172),
		Parent = npc,
	})
	local headMesh = Instance.new("SpecialMesh")
	headMesh.MeshType = Enum.MeshType.Head
	headMesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1.2, 1.2, 1.2)
	headMesh.Parent = head

	-- Tóc / mũ cách điệu
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "Hair",
		Size = Vector3.new(1.4, 0.55, 1.4),
		CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(0, 5.2, 0.05),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(42, 34, 30),
		Parent = npc,
	})

	for _, xArm in ipairs({ -1.5, 1.5 }) do
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "Arm",
			Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1),
			CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(xArm, 3, 0),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 205, 172),
			Parent = npc,
		})
	end
	for _, xLeg in ipairs({ -0.5, 0.5 }) do
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "Leg",
			Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1),
			CFrame = cf * CFrame.new(xLeg, 1, 0),
			Color = pantsColor,
			Parent = npc,
		})
	end

	-- Bảng tên trên đầu NPC
	local bb = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	bb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(190, 42)
	bb.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, 2.6, 0)
	bb.MaxDistance = 48
	bb.AlwaysOnTop = false
	bb.Parent = head

	local tagBg = Instance.new("Frame")
	tagBg.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)

--!strict

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local CityConfig = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("CityConfig"))
local CityUtils = require(script.Parent.Parent:WaitForChild("CityUtils"))

local Buildings = {}

-- Helper dựng vỏ tòa nhà tầng trệt có cửa mở thật để người chơi bước vào trong
local function buildStorefrontShell(
	parent: Instance,
	name: string,
	center: Vector3,
	size: Vector3,
	wallColor: Color3,
	trimColor: Color3,
	doorSide: string -- "South" (+Z), "North" (-Z), "West" (-X), "East" (+X)
): Model
	local m = Instance.new("Model")
	m.Name = name
	m.Parent = parent

	local halfX = size.X / 2
	local halfZ = size.Z / 2
	local h = size.Y
	local wallThick = 1.2
	local doorWidth = 9
	local doorHeight = 9.5

	-- Sàn lát gạch bên trong
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "InteriorFloor",
		Size = Vector3.new(size.X - 0.4, 0.3, size.Z - 0.4),
		Position = center + Vector3.new(0, 0.15, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(224, 220, 212),
		Material = Enum.Material.Marble,
		Parent = m,
	})

	-- Mái & viền mái
	CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "RoofSlab",
		Size = Vector3.new(size.X + 1.4, 1.2, size.Z + 1.4),
		Position = center + Vector3.new(0, h + 0.6, 0),
		Color = trimColor,
		Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
		Parent = m,
	})

	-- Đèn trần ấm áp bên trong tòa nhà
	local ceilingLamp = CityUtils.makePart({
		Name = "CeilingLight",
		Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.25, 6),
		Position = center + Vector3.new(0, h - 0.2, 0),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 244, 214),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CanCollide = false,
		Parent = m,
	})
	local pLight = Instance.new("PointLight")
	pLight.Range = 36
	pLight.Brightness = 1.6
	pLight.Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 205)
	pLight.Parent = ceilingLamp

	local function buildWallWithDoorX(zOffset: number, hasDoor: boolean)
		if not hasDoor then
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "Wall",
				Size = Vector3.new(size.X, h, wallThick),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(0, h / 2, zOffset),
				Color = wallColor,
				Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				Parent = m,
			})
			return
		end
		local sideW = (size.X - doorWidth) / 2
		-- Hai mảng kính mặt tiền hai bên cửa
		for _, signX in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local xPos = signX * (doorWidth / 2 + sideW / 2)
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "FrontLowWall",
				Size = Vector3.new(sideW, 2.2, wallThick),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(xPos, 1.1, zOffset),
				Color = wallColor,
				Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				Parent = m,
			})
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "FrontShowWindow",
				Size = Vector3.new(sideW - 1.2, doorHeight - 2.2, 0.35),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(xPos, 2.2 + (doorHeight - 2.2) / 2, zOffset),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(165, 220, 245),
				Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
				Transparency = 0.45,
				Parent = m,
			})
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "FrontUpperWall",
				Size = Vector3.new(sideW, h - doorHeight, wallThick),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(xPos, doorHeight + (h - doorHeight) / 2, zOffset),
				Color = wallColor,
				Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				Parent = m,
			})
		end
		-- Đà ngang phía trên cửa chính
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "DoorHeader",
			Size = Vector3.new(doorWidth, h - doorHeight, wallThick),
			Position = center + Vector3.new(0, doorHeight + (h - doorHeight) / 2, zOffset),
			Color = wallColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			Parent = m,
		})
	end

	local function buildWallWithDoorZ(xOffset: number, hasDoor: boolean)
		if not hasDoor then
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "Wall",
				Size = Vector3.new(wallThick, h, size.Z),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(xOffset, h / 2, 0),
				Color = wallColor,
				Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				Parent = m,
			})
			return
		end
		local sideZ = (size.Z - doorWidth) / 2
		for _, signZ in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			local zPos = signZ * (doorWidth / 2 + sideZ / 2)
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "SideLowWall",
				Size = Vector3.new(wallThick, 2.2, sideZ),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(xOffset, 1.1, zPos),
				Color = wallColor,
				Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				Parent = m,
			})
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "SideShowWindow",
				Size = Vector3.new(0.35, doorHeight - 2.2, sideZ - 1.2),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(xOffset, 2.2 + (doorHeight - 2.2) / 2, zPos),
				Color = Color3.fromRGB(165, 220, 245),
				Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
				Transparency = 0.45,
				Parent = m,
			})
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "SideUpperWall",
				Size = Vector3.new(wallThick, h - doorHeight, sideZ),
				Position = center + Vector3.new(xOffset, doorHeight + (h - doorHeight) / 2, zPos),
				Color = wallColor,
				Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
				Parent = m,
			})
		end
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "DoorHeader",
			Size = Vector3.new(wallThick, h - doorHeight, doorWidth),
			Position = center + Vector3.new(xOffset, doorHeight + (h - doorHeight) / 2, 0),
			Color = wallColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			Parent = m,
		})
	end

	buildWallWithDoorX(halfZ - wallThick / 2, doorSide == "South")
	buildWallWithDoorX(-halfZ + wallThick / 2, doorSide == "North")
	buildWallWithDoorZ(-halfX + wallThick / 2, doorSide == "West")
	buildWallWithDoorZ(halfX - wallThick / 2, doorSide == "East")

	return m
end

-- Helper trang trí các tầng cao ốc có dải cửa sổ phát sáng về đêm
local function addTowerUpperFloors(
	parent: Instance,
	baseCenter: Vector3,
	widthX: number,
	widthZ: number,
	floors: number,
	floorHeight: number,
	facadeColor: Color3,
	windowColor: Color3,
	neonAccent: Color3
): number
	for f = 1, floors do
		local yMid = baseCenter.Y + (f - 0.5) * floorHeight
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "TowerCore_F" .. tostring(f),
			Size = Vector3.new(widthX - 1.2, floorHeight - 0.8, widthZ - 1.2),
			Position = Vector3.new(baseCenter.X, yMid, baseCenter.Z),
			Color = facadeColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Concrete,
			Parent = parent,
		})
		local winBand = CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "WindowBand_F" .. tostring(f),
			Size = Vector3.new(widthX, floorHeight * 0.58, widthZ),
			Position = Vector3.new(baseCenter.X, yMid + 0.3, baseCenter.Z),
			Color = windowColor,
			Material = Enum.Material.Glass,
			Reflectance = 0.2,
			Parent = parent,
		})
		CollectionService:AddTag(winBand, CityConfig.WindowGlowTag)

		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "FloorLedge_F" .. tostring(f),
			Size = Vector3.new(widthX + 0.8, 0.7, widthZ + 0.8),
			Position = Vector3.new(baseCenter.X, baseCenter.Y + f * floorHeight, baseCenter.Z),
			Color = facadeColor:Lerp(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.15),
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			Parent = parent,
		})
	end

	local totalH = floors * floorHeight
	-- 4 dải đèn kiến trúc dọc 4 góc tòa tháp
	for _, sx in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
		for _, sz in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
			CityUtils.makePart({
				Name = "CornerNeonFin",
				Size = Vector3.new(0.85, totalH, 0.85),
				Position = Vector3.new(
					baseCenter.X + sx * (widthX / 2 + 0.3),
					baseCenter.Y + totalH / 2,
					baseCenter.Z + sz * (widthZ / 2 + 0.3)
				),
				Color = neonAccent,
				Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
				CanCollide = false,
				Parent = parent,
			})
		end
	end

	return baseCenter.Y + totalH
end

	-- ========================================================================

		Position = Vector3.new(skyCenter.X, roofY + 0.52, skyCenter.Z),
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21),
		Material = Enum.Material.Neon,
		CanCollide = false,

	-- Lan can kính an toàn trên đỉnh tháp

local function drawDashedLineZ(parent: Instance, xPos: number, zStart: number, zEnd: number, color: Color3)
	local z = zStart
	while z + 6 <= zEnd do
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "LaneDash",
			Size = Vector3.new(0.45, 0.05, 6),
			Position = Vector3.new(xPos, 0.52, z + 3),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = parent,
		})
		z += 12
	end
end

local function drawDashedLineX(parent: Instance, zPos: number, xStart: number, xEnd: number, color: Color3)
	local x = xStart
	while x + 6 <= xEnd do
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "LaneDash",
			Size = Vector3.new(6, 0.05, 0.45),
			Position = Vector3.new(x + 3, 0.52, zPos),
			Color = color,
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = parent,
		})
		x += 12
	end
end

local function drawCrosswalkAcrossX(parent: Instance, centerZ: number, halfWidth: number)
	local x = -halfWidth + 2.5
	while x <= halfWidth - 2.5 do
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "CrosswalkStripe",
			Size = Vector3.new(1.8, 0.06, 6.5),
			Position = Vector3.new(x, 0.525, centerZ),
			Color = Color3.fromRGB(242, 244, 248),
			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = parent,
		})
		x += 3.8
	end
end

local function drawCrosswalkAcrossZ(parent: Instance, centerX: number, halfWidth: number)
	local z = -halfWidth + 2.5
	while z <= halfWidth - 2.5 do
		CityUtils.makePart({
			Name = "CrosswalkStripe",
			Size = Vector3.new(6.5, 0.06, 1.8),

			Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic,
			CanCollide = false,
			Parent = parent,
		})
		z += 3.8
	end
end

--!strict

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local CityConfig = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CityConfig"))

local CitySimulation = {}

local configuredVehicles: { [Model]: boolean } = {}

type VehicleRuntime = {
	model: Model,
	chassis: BasePart,
	seat: VehicleSeat,
	linVel: LinearVelocity,
	alignOri: AlignOrientation,
	yaw: number,
	speed: number,
}

local activeVehicles: { VehicleRuntime } = {}

function CitySimulation.setupVehicle(car: Model)
	if configuredVehicles[car] then
		return
	end
	local chassis = car.PrimaryPart or car:FindFirstChild("Chassis")
	local seat = car:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat")
	if not chassis or not chassis:IsA("BasePart") or not seat or not seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		return
	end

	configuredVehicles[car] = true

	-- Hàn gắn toàn bộ chi tiết thân xe vào Chassis trước khi bỏ neo vật lý
	for _, desc in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") and desc ~= chassis then
			desc.Massless = true
			local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
			weld.Part0 = chassis
			weld.Part1 = desc
			weld.Parent = chassis
		end
	end

	for _, desc in ipairs(car:GetDescendants()) do
		if desc:IsA("BasePart") then
			desc.Anchored = false
		end
	end

	local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
	att.Name = "DriveAttachment"
	att.Parent = chassis

	local linVel = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
	linVel.Name = "ArcadeDriveVelocity"
	linVel.Attachment0 = att
	linVel.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
	linVel.VelocityConstraintMode = Enum.VelocityConstraintMode.Plane
	linVel.PrimaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
	linVel.SecondaryTangentAxis = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
	linVel.MaxForce = 120000
	linVel.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.zero
	linVel.Parent = chassis

	local _, startYaw, _ = chassis.CFrame:ToOrientation()

	local alignOri = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
	alignOri.Name = "ArcadeUprightSteering"
	alignOri.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
	alignOri.Attachment0 = att
	alignOri.MaxTorque = 180000
	alignOri.Responsiveness = 22
	alignOri.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, startYaw, 0)
	alignOri.Parent = chassis

	table.insert(activeVehicles, {
		model = car,
		chassis = chassis,
		seat = seat,
		linVel = linVel,
		alignOri = alignOri,
		yaw = startYaw,
		speed = 0,
	})
end

function CitySimulation.updateNightLights()
	local clock = Lighting.ClockTime
	local isNight = (clock >= 17.6 or clock <= 6.3)

	for _, bulb in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(CityConfig.StreetLightTag)) do
		if bulb:IsA("BasePart") then
			bulb.Material = if isNight then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			bulb.Color = if isNight then Color3.fromRGB(255, 232, 185) else Color3.fromRGB(190, 195, 205)
			local spot = bulb:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpotLight")
			if spot then
				spot.Enabled = isNight
			end
		end
	end

	for _, win in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(CityConfig.WindowGlowTag)) do
		if win:IsA("BasePart") then
			win.Material = if isNight then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.Glass
			win.Reflectance = if isNight then 0 else 0.22
		end
	end
end

local function setTrafficAxisState(axisName: string, activeLamp: string)
	for _, tl in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(CityConfig.TrafficLightTag)) do
		if tl:GetAttribute("Axis") == axisName then
			local box = tl:FindFirstChild("SignalBox")
			if box then
				for _, colorName in ipairs({ "Red", "Yellow", "Green" }) do
					local lens = tl:FindFirstChild(colorName)
					if lens and lens:IsA("BasePart") then
						local isOn = (colorName == activeLamp)
						local onCol = lens:GetAttribute("OnColor")
						local offCol = lens:GetAttribute("OffColor")
						if typeof(onCol) == "Color3" and typeof(offCol) == "Color3" then
							lens.Color = if isOn then onCol else offCol
						end
						lens.Material = if isOn then Enum.Material.Neon else Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function CitySimulation.start()
	for _, car in ipairs(CollectionService:GetTagged(CityConfig.VehicleTag)) do
		if car:IsA("Model") then
			CitySimulation.setupVehicle(car)
		end
	end
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(CityConfig.VehicleTag):Connect(function(inst)
		if inst:IsA("Model") then
			task.defer(function()
				CitySimulation.setupVehicle(inst)
			end)
		end
	end)

	CitySimulation.updateNightLights()

	-- Vòng lặp vật lý lái xe mượt mà 60fps
	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		for i = #activeVehicles, 1, -1 do
			local v = activeVehicles[i]
			if not v.model.Parent or not v.chassis.Parent then
				table.remove(activeVehicles, i)
				continue
			end

			local throttle = v.seat.ThrottleFloat
			local steer = v.seat.SteerFloat
			local hasDriver = v.seat.Occupant ~= nil

			local nitroUntil = tonumber(v.model:GetAttribute("NitroUntil")) or 0
			local maxSpeed = if os.clock() < nitroUntil then 96 else 66

			if hasDriver and math.abs(throttle) > 0.02 then
				local targetSpeed = throttle * maxSpeed
				local accel = if throttle > 0 then 52 else 44
				v.speed += math.clamp(targetSpeed - v.speed, -accel * dt, accel * dt)
			else
				local drag = if hasDriver then 36 else 55
				if math.abs(v.speed) <= drag * dt then
					v.speed = 0
				else
					v.speed -= math.sign(v.speed) * drag * dt
				end
			end

			if hasDriver and math.abs(v.speed) > 1.2 and math.abs(steer) > 0.02 then
				local reverseFactor = if v.speed >= 0 then 1 else -1
				local turnRate = 1.95 * math.clamp(math.abs(v.speed) / 28, 0.35, 1.1)
				v.yaw -= steer * turnRate * reverseFactor * dt
				v.alignOri.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, v.yaw, 0)
			end

			local forward = CFrame.Angles(0, v.yaw, 0).LookVector
			v.linVel.PlaneVelocity = Vector2.new(forward.X * v.speed, forward.Z * v.speed)
		end
	end)

	-- Chu kỳ Đèn Giao Thông Ngã Tư + Thời gian Ngày/Đêm nhẹ nhàng
	task.spawn(function()
		local phases = {
			{ ns = "Green", ew = "Red", waitSec = 10 },
			{ ns = "Yellow", ew = "Red", waitSec = 2.5 },
			{ ns = "Red", ew = "Green", waitSec = 10 },
			{ ns = "Red", ew = "Yellow", waitSec = 2.5 },
		}
		local idx = 1
		while true do
			local p = phases[idx]
			setTrafficAxisState("NS", p.ns)
			setTrafficAxisState("EW", p.ew)
			CitySimulation.updateNightLights()
			task.wait(p.waitSec)
			Lighting.ClockTime = (Lighting.ClockTime + 0.06) % 24
			idx = (idx % #phases) + 1
		end
	end)
end

return CitySimulation

--!strict

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
local ProximityPromptService = game:GetService("ProximityPromptService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local Shared = ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild("Shared")
local CityConfig = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CityConfig"))
local CityUtils = require(Shared:WaitForChild("CityUtils"))
local CitySimulation = require(script.Parent:WaitForChild("CitySimulation"))

local InteractionManager = {}

local atmCooldowns: { [number]: number } = {}
local fountainPaletteIdx = 1
local timePresetIdx = 1
local aptLightIdx = 1
local playerSpawnedCars: { [number]: Model } = {}

local FOUNTAIN_COLORS = {
	{ name = "Xanh Ngọc Biển", col = Color3.fromRGB(34, 211, 238) },
	{ name = "Hồng Anh Đào", col = Color3.fromRGB(244, 114, 182) },
	{ name = "Vàng Hoàng Kim", col = Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21) },
	{ name = "Tím Ngân Hà", col = Color3.fromRGB(168, 85, 247) },
}

local TIME_PRESETS = {
	{ name = "Đêm Thành Phố Neon (21:30)", clock = 21.5 },
	{ name = "Ban Ngày Nắng Đẹp (10:30)", clock = 10.5 },
	{ name = "Hoàng Hôn Rực Rỡ (17:45)", clock = 17.8 },
}

local APT_LIGHT_COLORS = {
	{ name = "Tím Chill Cyber", col = Color3.fromRGB(192, 132, 252) },
	{ name = "Xanh Ngọc Lục Bảo", col = Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153) },
	{ name = "Trắng Ấm Gia Đình", col = Color3.fromRGB(255, 240, 205) },
}

local function getCash(player: Player): number
	return tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Cash")) or 0
end

local function addCash(player: Player, delta: number)
	local nextVal = math.max(0, getCash(player) + delta)
	player:SetAttribute("Cash", nextVal)
	local ls = player:FindFirstChild("leaderstats")
	local cashObj = if ls then ls:FindFirstChild("Tiền ($)") else nil
	if cashObj and cashObj:IsA("IntValue") then
		cashObj.Value = nextVal
	end
end

local function notify(notifyRemote: RemoteEvent, player: Player, kind: string, title: string, body: string, extra: any?)
	notifyRemote:FireClient(player, {
		kind = kind,
		title = title,
		body = body,
		extra = extra,
	})
end

local function giveDrinkTool(player: Player, itemInfo: any, notifyRemote: RemoteEvent)
	local tool = Instance.new("Tool")
	tool.Name = itemInfo.name
	tool.ToolTip = itemInfo.desc
	tool.GripPos = Vector3.new(0, -0.35, 0)

	local handle = Instance.new("Part")
	handle.Name = "Handle"
	handle.Shape = Enum.PartType.Cylinder
	handle.Size = Vector3.new(1.35, 0.9, 0.9)
	handle.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
	handle.Color = itemInfo.color
	handle.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	handle.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	handle.Parent = tool

	local straw = Instance.new("Part")
	straw.Name = "Straw"
	straw.Size = Vector3.new(0.14, 0.9, 0.14)
	straw.Color = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250)
	straw.CanCollide = false
	straw.Massless = true
	straw.CFrame = handle.CFrame * CFrame.new(0.65, 0.15, 0)
	straw.Parent = tool

	local weld = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
	weld.Part0 = handle
	weld.Part1 = straw
	weld.Parent = handle

	local used = false
	tool.Activated:Connect(function()
		if used then
			return
		end
		local char = tool.Parent
		local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
		if not hum then
			return
		end
		used = true
		hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
		player:SetAttribute("SpeedBoostValue", itemInfo.speedBoost)
		player:SetAttribute("SpeedBoostUntil", os.clock() + itemInfo.duration)
		hum.WalkSpeed = itemInfo.speedBoost

		notify(
			notifyRemote,
			player,
			"success",
			"⚡ Đã thưởng thức " .. itemInfo.name,
			string.format("Tốc độ chạy tăng lên %d trong %d giây!", itemInfo.speedBoost, itemInfo.duration)
		)
		task.delay(itemInfo.duration, function()
			if player.Parent and (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("SpeedBoostUntil")) or 0) <= os.clock() + 0.1 then
				player:SetAttribute("SpeedBoostValue", 0)
				local c = player.Character
				local h = if c then c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
				if h and h.WalkSpeed > 16 then
					h.WalkSpeed = 16
				end
			end
		end)
		tool:Destroy()
	end)

	local backpack = player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
	if backpack then
		tool.Parent = backpack
	end
end

local function attachNeonTrail(player: Player)
	local char = player.Character
	local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end
	local existing = hrp:FindFirstChild("CyberArcadeTrail")
	if existing then
		existing:Destroy()
	end

	local a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a0.Name = "TrailTop"
	a0.Position = Vector3.new(0, 1.2, 0)
	a0.Parent = hrp

	local a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
	a1.Name = "TrailBottom"
	a1.Position = Vector3.new(0, -1.2, 0)
	a1.Parent = hrp

	local trail = Instance.new("Trail")
	trail.Name = "CyberArcadeTrail"
	trail.Attachment0 = a0
	trail.Attachment1 = a1
	trail.Lifetime = 0.65
	trail.LightEmission = 1
	trail.Color = ColorSequence.new({
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(34, 211, 238)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(232, 121, 249)),
		ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(250, 204, 21)),
	})
	trail.Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0.1, 1)
	trail.Parent = hrp
end

function InteractionManager.start(notifyRemote: RemoteEvent)
	ProximityPromptService.PromptTriggered:Connect(function(prompt, player)
		if not CollectionService:HasTag(prompt, CityConfig.PromptTag) then
			return
		end

		local actionType = tostring(prompt:GetAttribute("ActionType") or "")

		if actionType == "UseATM" then
			local now = os.clock()
			local nextAllowed = atmCooldowns[player.UserId] or 0
			if now < nextAllowed then
				local remain = math.ceil(nextAllowed - now)
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"warn",
					"🏦 ATM Neo Bank",
					string.format("Bạn vừa rút trợ cấp rồi! Vui lòng quay lại sau %d giây.", remain)
				)
				return
			end
			atmCooldowns[player.UserId] = now + 35
			addCash(player, 150)
			notify(
				notifyRemote,
				player,
				"cash",
				"💵 Rút Tiền Thành Công (+$150)",
				"Bạn đã nhận $150 trợ cấp công dân Thành Phố Ánh Sáng!"
			)

		elseif actionType == "BuyItem" then
			local itemId = tostring(prompt:GetAttribute("ItemId") or "")
			local itemInfo = (CityConfig.Items :: any)[itemId]
			if not itemInfo then
				return
			end
			if getCash(player) < itemInfo.price then
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"warn",
					"Không đủ tiền mặt",
					string.format("Món %s có giá $%d. Hãy ghé ATM hoặc đi giao Pizza nhé!", itemInfo.name, itemInfo.price)
				)
				return
			end
			addCash(player, -itemInfo.price)
			giveDrinkTool(player, itemInfo, notifyRemote)
			notify(
				notifyRemote,
				player,
				"success",
				"🥤 Đã mua " .. itemInfo.name,
				"Món đồ đã vào Balo (phím 1-9) — cầm lên và nhấp chuột để uống tăng tốc!"
			)

		elseif actionType == "StartDelivery" then
			local currentTarget = player:GetAttribute("DeliveryTargetId")
			if type(currentTarget) == "string" and currentTarget ~= "" then
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"info",
					"📦 Đang có đơn hàng!",
					"Hãy giao đơn hiện tại tới: " .. tostring(player:GetAttribute("DeliveryTargetName"))
				)
				return
			end
			local targets = CityConfig.DeliveryTargets
			local chosen = targets[math.random(1, #targets)]
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryTargetId", chosen.id)
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryTargetName", chosen.name)
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryReward", chosen.reward)
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryTargetPos", chosen.position)

			notify(
				notifyRemote,
				player,
				"quest",
				"🍕 Đơn Giao Hàng Mới!",
				string.format("Giao tới %s để nhận thưởng $%d! (Đã bật điểm chỉ đường trên màn hình)", chosen.name, chosen.reward)
			)

		elseif actionType == "DeliverOrder" then
			local pointId = tostring(prompt:GetAttribute("TargetId") or "")
			local activeId = tostring(player:GetAttribute("DeliveryTargetId") or "")
			if activeId == "" then
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"info",
					"Chưa nhận đơn hàng",
					"Hãy ghé tiệm Pizza Hot & 24/7 Mart ở Phố Thương Mại để nhận đơn giao hàng nhé!"
				)
				return
			end
			if activeId ~= pointId then
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"warn",
					"Nhầm địa chỉ giao hàng!",
					"Đơn hiện tại cần giao tới: " .. tostring(player:GetAttribute("DeliveryTargetName"))
				)
				return
			end
			local baseReward = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("DeliveryReward")) or 90
			local streak = (tonumber(player:GetAttribute("DeliveryStreak")) or 0) + 1
			local bonus = math.min((streak - 1) * 15, 60)
			local total = baseReward + bonus

			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryStreak", streak)
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryTargetId", "")
			player:SetAttribute("DeliveryTargetName", "")
			addCash(player, total)

			notify(
				notifyRemote,
				player,
				"cash",
				string.format("🎉 Giao Hàng Xuất Sắc! (+$%d)", total),
				string.format("Chuỗi giao hàng liên tiếp x%d! Ghé Pizza Hot để nhận chuyến tiếp theo.", streak)
			)

		elseif actionType == "SpawnVehicle" then
			local cityRoot = workspace:FindFirstChild(CityConfig.CityFolderName)
			local vehiclesFolder = if cityRoot then cityRoot:FindFirstChild("Vehicles") else workspace
			local oldCar = playerSpawnedCars[player.UserId]
			if oldCar and oldCar.Parent then
				oldCar:Destroy()
			end

			local style = tostring(prompt:GetAttribute("CarStyle") or "RedSport")
			local carColor = if style == "CyanCyber"
				then Color3.fromRGB(14, 165, 233)
				else Color3.fromRGB(225, 38, 52)

			local spawnCf = CFrame.lookAt(Vector3.new(102, 0.6, 8), Vector3.new(40, 0.6, 8))
			local newCar = CityUtils.buildVehicleModel(
				vehiclesFolder or workspace,
				spawnCf,
				carColor,
				player.Name .. "_Car"
			)
			playerSpawnedCars[player.UserId] = newCar
			CitySimulation.setupVehicle(newCar)

			local char = player.Character
			local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			local seat = newCar:FindFirstChild("DriverSeat")
			if hum and seat and seat:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
				seat:Sit(hum)
			end

			notify(
				notifyRemote,
				player,
				"success",
				"🏎️ Đã gọi xe thành công!",
				"Dùng phím W / A / S / D để lái xe dạo quanh đại lộ Thành Phố Ánh Sáng!"
			)

		elseif actionType == "UseElevator" then
			local char = player.Character
			local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
			if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
				local dx = tonumber(prompt:GetAttribute("DestX")) or 0
				local dy = tonumber(prompt:GetAttribute("DestY")) or 5
				local dz = tonumber(prompt:GetAttribute("DestZ")) or 0
				local label = tostring(prompt:GetAttribute("Label") or "Tầng mới")
				hrp.CFrame = CFrame.new(dx, dy, dz)
				notify(notifyRemote, player, "info", "🛗 Thang Máy SkyTower", "Đã di chuyển tới: " .. label)
			end

		elseif actionType == "SkyLaunch" then
			local char = player.Character
			local hrp = if char then char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") else nil
			if hrp and hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
				local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
				att.Parent = hrp
				local lv = Instance.new("LinearVelocity")
				lv.Attachment0 = att
				lv.MaxForce = 95000
				lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(46, 52, 46)
				lv.Parent = hrp

				task.delay(0.65, function()
					if lv.Parent then
						-- Chế độ lượn dù êm ái ngắm toàn thành phố
						lv.VectorVelocity = Vector3.new(26, -7.5, 26)
					end
				end)
				task.delay(7.5, function()
					if lv.Parent then
						lv:Destroy()
					end
					if att.Parent then
						att:Destroy()
					end
				end)
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"success",
					"🪂 Đang Bay Dù Lượn Ngắm Thành Phố!",
					"Tận hưởng góc nhìn toàn cảnh từ đỉnh SkyTower xuống Vịnh Biển!"
				)
			end

		elseif actionType == "CycleTime" then
			local preset = TIME_PRESETS[timePresetIdx]
			timePresetIdx = (timePresetIdx % #TIME_PRESETS) + 1
			Lighting.ClockTime = preset.clock
			CitySimulation.updateNightLights()
			notify(
				notifyRemote,
				player,
				"info",
				"🌤️ Đã chuyển bầu trời thành phố",
				"Thời gian hiện tại: " .. preset.name
			)

		elseif actionType == "FountainWish" then
			fountainPaletteIdx = (fountainPaletteIdx % #FOUNTAIN_COLORS) + 1
			local choice = FOUNTAIN_COLORS[fountainPaletteIdx]
			local fountainModel = if prompt.Parent then prompt.Parent.Parent else nil
			if fountainModel then
				local water = fountainModel:FindFirstChild("FountainWater")
				local crystal = fountainModel:FindFirstChild("FountainCrystal")
				if water and water:IsA("BasePart") then
					water.Color = choice.col
				end
				if crystal and crystal:IsA("BasePart") then
					crystal.Color = choice.col
					local pl = crystal:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
					if pl then
						pl.Color = choice.col
					end
				end
			end
			addCash(player, 20)
			notify(
				notifyRemote,
				player,
				"cash",
				"⛲ Ước Nguyện Đài Phun Nước (+$20)",
				"Đài phun nước đã chuyển sang sắc màu: " .. choice.name
			)

		elseif actionType == "ToggleDoor" then
			local door = prompt.Parent
			if door and door:IsA("BasePart") then
				local closedPos = door:GetAttribute("ClosedPos")
				if typeof(closedPos) ~= "Vector3" then
					closedPos = door.Position
					door:SetAttribute("ClosedPos", closedPos)
				end
				local isOpen = door:GetAttribute("IsOpen") == true
				local targetPos = if isOpen then closedPos else (closedPos + Vector3.new(8.2, 0, 0))
				door:SetAttribute("IsOpen", not isOpen)
				TweenService:Create(door, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {
					Position = targetPos,
				}):Play()
			end

		elseif actionType == "ToggleAptLight" then
			local choice = APT_LIGHT_COLORS[aptLightIdx]
			aptLightIdx = (aptLightIdx % #APT_LIGHT_COLORS) + 1
			local aptModel = if prompt.Parent then prompt.Parent.Parent else nil
			if aptModel then
				local lamp = aptModel:FindFirstChild("CeilingLight")
				if lamp and lamp:IsA("BasePart") then
					lamp.Color = choice.col
					local pl = lamp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PointLight")
					if pl then
						pl.Color = choice.col
					end
				end
			end
			notify(notifyRemote, player, "info", "🏠 Nhà Thông Minh Lumina", "Đèn phòng khách: " .. choice.name)

		elseif actionType == "PlayArcade" then
			if getCash(player) < 20 then
				notify(notifyRemote, player, "warn", "Cần $20 xu Arcade", "Hãy ghé ATM rút trợ cấp để chơi nhé!")
				return
			end
			addCash(player, -20)
			local roll = math.random(1, 100)
			attachNeonTrail(player)
			if roll >= 65 then
				addCash(player, 90)
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"cash",
					"🎰 JACKPOT CYBER ARCADE! (+$90)",
					"Bạn vừa trúng giải lớn và nhận hiệu ứng Hào Quang Neon rực rỡ!"
				)
			else
				addCash(player, 25)
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"success",
					"🕹️ Thắng giải Arcade! (+$25)",
					"Đã kích hoạt hiệu ứng Hào Quang Neon đa sắc sau lưng nhân vật!"
				)
			end

		elseif actionType == "NitroBoost" then
			local foundCar: Model? = nil
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			if hum and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart.Parent and hum.SeatPart.Parent:IsA("Model") then
				foundCar = hum.SeatPart.Parent
			else
				foundCar = playerSpawnedCars[player.UserId]
			end
			if foundCar and foundCar.Parent then
				foundCar:SetAttribute("NitroUntil", os.clock() + 45)
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"success",
					"🔥 Đã Nạp Nhiên Liệu NITRO!",
					"Tốc độ tối đa xe của bạn tăng lên 96 trong 45 giây!"
				)
			elseif hum then
				hum.WalkSpeed = 28
				task.delay(25, function()
					if hum.Parent and hum.WalkSpeed == 28 then
						hum.WalkSpeed = 16
					end
				end)
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"success",
					"⚡ Năng Lượng Petro Metro!",
					"Tăng tốc độ chạy bộ trong 25 giây! (Hãy lái xe vào trạm để nạp Nitro cho xe)"
				)
			end

		elseif actionType == "HealPlayer" then
			local char = player.Character
			local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
			if hum then
				hum.Health = hum.MaxHealth
				notify(
					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"success",
					"💚 Bệnh Viện Đa Khoa Metro",
					"Sức khoẻ & thể lực của bạn đã được hồi phục 100%!"
				)
			end

		elseif actionType == "NpcTalk" then
			local npcId = tostring(prompt:GetAttribute("NpcId") or "")
			local dlg = (CityConfig.NpcDialogues :: any)[npcId]
			if dlg then

					notifyRemote,
					player,
					"dialogue",
					dlg.title,
					table.concat(dlg.lines, "\n")
				)
			end
		end
	end)
end

		accent = Color3.fromRGB(52, 211, 153)

	}):Play()

local function detectDistrictName(pos: Vector3): string
	for _, d in ipairs(CityConfig.Districts) do
		if
			pos.X >= d.min.X
			and pos.X <= d.max.X
			and pos.Z >= d.min.Z
			and pos.Z <= d.max.Z
		then
			return d.name
		end
	end
	return "Đại Lộ Trung Tâm Thành Phố"
end

	local hum = if char then char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") else nil
	if not hrp or not hrp:IsA("BasePart") then
		return
	end

	zoneLabel.Text = "📍 " .. detectDistrictName(pos)

	if hum and hum.SeatPart and hum.SeatPart:IsA("VehicleSeat") then
		local kmh = math.round(hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude * 1.1)
		speedoLabel.Text = string.format("🏎️ %d km/h", kmh)
	else
		speedoLabel.Text = ""
	end

	if waypointPart and waypointLabel then
		local targetPos = localPlayer:GetAttribute("DeliveryTargetPos")
		local targetName = tostring(localPlayer:GetAttribute("DeliveryTargetName") or "Điểm giao")
		if typeof(targetPos) == "Vector3" then
			local dist = math.round((pos - targetPos).Magnitude)
			waypointLabel.Text = string.format("📦 %s\nCách %d m", targetName, dist)
		end
	end
end)
